properties.description:
JCI will supply, install, program, test, and commission a Hardwired intrusion system using a Honeywell Vista 20 series panel. All existing field devices will be replaced, but existing wiring may be reused where feasible. This option provides a cost effective, conventional IDS alternative. Exterior doors will receive overhead door contacts to resolve door gap issues. Interior doors will receive new surface contacts. All motion and glass breaks will be replaced.  Headend: System includes a Honeywell VISTA-20P Control Panel, an expansion zone module, a hardwired keypad and a new Verizon cell communicator with a high range antenna.  Field Device: Door Contacts, Glass break, Motion detectors and Overhead contacts for all exterior doors.  Cable: Existing wiring may be reused where feasible.
 Installation shall comply with 2017 NEC.
